frac_m_dry_margin.dcep_description: total dry mass without margin to total mass fraction

frac_mass_propellant.dcep_description: propellant mass to total mass fraction

frac_mass_payload.dcep_description: total payload mass to total mass fraction

frac_mass_thermal.dcep_description: total thermal system mass to total mass fraction

frac_mass_power.dcep_description: total power system mass to total mass fraction

frac_mass_other.dcep_description: misscellameous to total mass fraction, can be considered to be a margin

power_thruster.dcep_description: Total electric power consumption of the propulsion system

propellant.dcep_description: Describes the current propellant used by the propulsion system

c_e.dcep_description: Effective exhaust velocity of the propulsion system

eff_PPU.dcep_description: Power conversion efficiency of the Power Propulsion Unit (PPU)

eff_thruster.dcep_description: El. power to jet power conversion efficiency of the thruster

maneuver_duration.dcep_description: Total time to perform the full dv of all maneuvres.

evolution_success.dcep_description: Flags the sucess of the recent generation. Relevant for algorithm analysis and debugging.

n_success.dcep_description: Counter for convergence of lineage. Relevant for algorithm analysis and debugging.

subsystem_powers.dcep_description: Power requirement of all spacecraft subsystems

frac_power_payload.dcep_description: power demand fraction of the payload

frac_p_structure.dcep_description: power demand fraction for operation structures and mechanisms

frac_power_thermal.dcep_description: power demand fraction for thermal control

frac_power_power.dcep_description: power demand fraction for power conditioning

frac_p_ttc.dcep_description: power demand fraction for tracking telemetry and command

frac_p_obc.dcep_description: power demand fraction for on-board computer

frac_p_adc.dcep_description: power demand fraction for attitude determination and control

frac_propulsion_power.dcep_description: power demand fraction for propulsion systems

convergence.dcep_description: Indicator of lineage has converged, should always be 1

system.dcep_description: Parametric modelled system parameters are listed here

power.dcep_description: Power system parameters are listed here

heat.dcep_description: Worst case generated heat of this component

PV.dcep_description: Photovoltaic system parameters are listed here

PV_power_output_required.dcep_description: Photovoltaic cells worst case output required power

PV_eff_area_required.dcep_description: Photovoltaic required total area for worst case power assumption

Q_PV_solar_irradiance.dcep_description: Worst case heat on photovoltaic cells created by solar irradiance

battery.dcep_description: Parameters of the required battery system are listed here

E_battery_required_max.dcep_description: Maximum to be stored electrical energy

converter.dcep_description: parameters of the power conversion system listed here

I_PDU_in.dcep_description: Maximum input current of PV to batt

I_PDU_out.dcep_description: Maximum output current of batt to sat

n_cycles_per_year.dcep_description: Number of battery cycles required for a full year stay in nominal orbit

p_a_mean.dcep_description: Mean solar irradiance constant of nominal orbit

p_a_min.dcep_description: Minimum solar irradiance constant of nominal orbit

p_a_max.dcep_description: Maximum solar irradiance constant of nominal orbit

p_consumed_max.dcep_description: Maximum output power to be consumed from batteries in worst case

power_margin.dcep_description: Reference standard power margin applied for system design.

height.dcep_description: Reference orbit height above Earrth center for circular nominal orbit

velocity.dcep_description: Mean velocity for circular nominal orbit

orbit.dcep_description: Time to complete full orbit revolution

shadow.dcep_description: Orbit shadow times are listed here

umbra.dcep_description: Time spacecraft in core shadow umbra for nominal orbit

penumbra.dcep_description: Time spacecraft in partial shadow penumbra for nominal orbit

average_light.dcep_description: Averaged time spacecraft in illumination for nominal orbit

full_light.dcep_description: Time spacecraft in full light for nominal orbit

comm_max.dcep_description: Time spacecraft in possible communication with groundstation with direct overpass, passing from horizon to horizon

magneticfield.dcep_description: Earth equatorial magnetic field strength at nominal orbit height

system_geometry.dcep_description: Estimated bounding-box geometry of the spacecraft derived from statistical scaling laws

size_x.dcep_description: Estimated spacecraft bounding box width (x-dimension) from mass scaling law

size_y.dcep_description: Estimated spacecraft bounding box depth (y-dimension) from mass scaling law

size_h.dcep_description: Estimated spacecraft bounding box height (h-dimension) from mass scaling law

volume_box.dcep_description: Estimated spacecraft bounding box volume: size_x * size_y * size_h. Statistical estimate based on historical spacecraft data.

volume_box_scaled.dcep_description: Independent cross-check: bounding box volume estimated directly from total mass via mass-to-volume_box scaling law

totalimpulse.dcep_description: Total impulse of the propulsion system

deltav.dcep_description: Total velocity increment of the mission

thrust_mode.dcep_description: Thrust mode of the propulsion system (e.g. continuous or pulsed)

mass_structmech.dcep_description: total structural and mechanisms mass. based on statistics.

mass_ttc.dcep_description: total telemetry, tracking and control system mass. based on statistics.

mass_adc.dcep_description: total attitude determination and control system mass. based on statistics.

power_structmech.dcep_description: power demand for operation of structures and mechanisms

power_ttc.dcep_description: power demand for tracking telemetry and command

power_adc.dcep_description: power demand for attitude determination and control

frac_mass_structmech.dcep_name: total structural and mechanisms mass fraction
frac_mass_structmech.dcep_description: total structural and mechanisms mass to total mass fraction

frac_mass_ttc.dcep_description: total telemetry, tracking and control system mass to total mass fraction

frac_mass_adc.dcep_description: total attitude determination and control system mass to total mass fraction

count_for_convergence.dcep_description: Counter tracking how many successive generations have met the convergence criterion

convergence_mode.dcep_description: Current convergence state of the lineage evolution (active or converged)

PDU_efficiency.dcep_description: Assumed power distribution unit efficiency for power budgeting

orbit_power_parameters.dcep_description: Derived orbital parameters used for power system sizing (solar irradiance, power consumption, margin)

shadow_total.dcep_description: Total shadow time per orbit (umbra plus penumbra)

mission_duration.dcep_description: User-specified total mission lifetime. Combined with propulsion_time_fraction to derive the maximum allowable burn time and thus the minimum required thrust.

maneuver_duration_max.dcep_description: User-specified upper limit on total propulsion burn time. Directly constrains minimum required thrust via F_min = m_prop * c_e / t_burn_max.

propulsion_time_fraction.dcep_description: Fraction of mission duration allocated for propulsion burns. Default 0.10 (10%), based on SMAD 2011 p.693 ff., typical EP duty cycles of 5-20% of mission lifetime.

thrust_min.dcep_description: Minimum thrust to complete the maneuver within the allowed burn time: F_min = m_prop * c_e / t_burn_max. Hard constraint in the evolutionary search.

maneuver_duration_actual.dcep_description: Maneuver duration computed from the selected thruster cluster: t = m_prop * c_e / F_cluster. May differ from maneuver_duration (design variable) when the discrete hardware thrust differs from the continuous optimised thrust.

thrust_min_satisfied.dcep_name: Mission time constraint satisfied by hardware
thrust_min_satisfied.dcep_description: 1 if the selected thruster cluster thrust meets the minimum thrust requirement derived from the mission time constraint, 0 otherwise.

required_mass_payload.dcep_description: User-specified minimum payload mass. When provided, mutations that reduce mass_payload below this floor are hard-rejected. Empty when payload mass is a free variable.

required_power_payload.dcep_description: User-specified minimum payload power. When provided, mutations that reduce power_payload below this floor are hard-rejected. Empty when payload power is a free variable.

scaling_quality.dcep_description: Per-parameter and aggregate confidence metrics for all SMAD statistical scaling evaluations. Quantifies how well the source database supports each estimate.

total_score.dcep_description: Aggregate confidence score in [0,1] derived as the minimum over all mass and power scaling parameters. Score 0.70 and above: high (green); 0.40 to 0.70: medium (yellow); below 0.40: low (red).

total_label.dcep_description: Human-readable confidence class: high (score 0.70 and above), medium (score 0.40 to 0.70), or low (score below 0.40). Corresponds to green/yellow/red traffic-light scheme.

total_regime.dcep_description: interpolation when all parameters are within the source data range; extrapolation when at least one parameter is outside the source data range.

mass_score.dcep_description: Minimum confidence score over all SMAD mass-fraction scaling parameters (mass_payload through mass_other).

power_score.dcep_description: Minimum confidence score over all SMAD power-fraction scaling parameters (power_payload through propulsion_power).

score.dcep_description: Confidence score in [0,1] for a single scaling evaluation. Interpolation: n_factor*(1-gap_fraction), clamped [0.30,1.00]. Extrapolation: 0.30*(1-extrap_fraction), max 0.30.

regime.dcep_description: interpolation: query x is within the source data range. extrapolation: query x is outside the source data range. Ref: Draper & Smith, Applied Regression Analysis, 3rd ed., Wiley 1998, s3.8.

label.dcep_description: high (score 0.70 and above), medium (score 0.40 to 0.70), or low (score below 0.40). Traffic-light colour scheme as requested by REQ-MOST-FUNC-0140.

gap_fraction.dcep_description: Span of the bracketing source-data interval (or extrapolation extent) divided by the total source data range. 0=query is at a data point, 1=maximally far from all source points.

n_source_points.dcep_name: Number of source data points (per parameter)
n_source_points.dcep_description: Count of original (non-interpolated) data points in the scaling CSV for this parameter. Used in the n_factor penalty: n_factor=min(1,(n-1)/4). Ref: Stone (1974), JRSS-B 36(2):111.
